How the content is organized
Source lives under content/. Each first-level directory is a part in the sidebar:



Folder
Role

Orientation and overview


content/01-foundations/
Core material


content/99-appendices/
Optional extras (add when needed)


content/_planning/
Notes only — ignored by the index script



Chapter order is filename order. Prefer numeric prefixes:
content/01-foundations/01-getting-started.qmd
content/01-foundations/02-core-ideas.qmd
